label: Session 1
title: The language of myopia management: aligning definitions with evidence and recent developments
axis: 建立近視管理的語言：從度數控制延伸到眼軸、病理風險與 lifelong eye care。

label: Session 2
title: Science that protects vision and ocular health over time: insights from longitudinal and randomised controlled trials, and behavioural science principles
axis: 以長期臨床研究、真實世界資料與行為科學，說明治療效果如何在日常照護中被實現。

label: Session 3
title: Integrating evidence, experience and efficiency in myopia management
axis: 聚焦亞洲臨床導入、個別化治療、組合療法與實務效率。
